data.description: Fully Furnished 1 Bedroom Apartment with Private Pool | Binghatti Royale | Luxury Living
data.display_address: Binghatti Royale, District 18, Jumeirah Village Circle, Dubai
data.long_description:
Step into comfort and style with this beautifully fully furnished 1-bedroom apartment located in the prestigious Binghatti Royale, set within the vibrant community of Jumeirah Village Circle. Offering a modern layout, tasteful interiors, and ready-to-move-in convenience, this home is ideal for professionals or couples seeking a hassle-free lifestyle in Dubai.
.
Property Details:

Rent: AED 110,000 per year
Size: 807.62 sq ft
Bedrooms: 1
Bathrooms: 2
Furnishing: Fully Furnished
Status: Ready to Move In

Apartment Features:

Stylish fully furnished living and dining area with modern furniture
Bright and spacious layout with floor-to-ceiling windows
Fully equipped kitchen with appliances and storage
Elegant 1 bedroom with built-in wardrobes and quality furnishings
2 modern bathrooms with premium fittings
Contemporary interiors with high-end décor
Thoughtfully designed layout for maximum comfort and functionality
Move-in ready condition
Private pool offering exclusive relaxation and leisure space

Building Amenities:

24/7 security and CCTV monitoring
Fully equipped gymnasium
Swimming pool
Covered parking
High-speed elevators
Luxurious lobby and reception area
Professional building maintenance services

Location Highlights: 

Located in Jumeirah Village Circle, Binghatti Royale offers excellent connectivity to major destinations across Dubai including Downtown Dubai, Dubai Marina, and Business Bay. With easy access to major highways, residents enjoy smooth commuting across the city.

The community also features parks, retail outlets, supermarkets, cafes, and essential services, making it a highly convenient and family-friendly neighborhood.
